描述_EN: mark: a lozenge (fang-shêng) in blue. blue and white porcelain with brown exterior. the inside is painted in underglaze blue with a formal design of six lotus-petal compartments filled with flowers radiating with stems between them, about a central lotus flower. printed in blue on the inside and in colours on the outside, within medallions over a brown glaze. the outside is covered with a light dead-leaf brown or café-au-lait glaze over which have been added four medallions painted alternatively with a long-legged bird and sprays of flowers in crimson, white and green enamel. overdecorated in england, probably staffordshire, early 18th century.
描述_ZN: 标记：蓝色的菱形（fang-shêng）。 蓝白相间的瓷器，外表为褐色。 内壁以釉下蓝彩绘出六个莲瓣格，花瓣间有花茎呈放射状，围绕着中央的一朵莲花。 内有蓝印花布，外有彩绘，在褐色釉面上的纹饰内。 外面覆盖着淡淡的枯叶棕色或咖啡色的釉，上面加了四个深红色、白色和绿色的珐琅彩的长脚鸟和花束的徽章，交替绘制。 英格兰过度装饰，可能是斯塔福德郡，18世纪初。
